title: Course Review
description: The closing Course Review of Collections & Streams: cumulative review and additional scenario practice that wraps up every topic of the course, followed by the course-level final MCQ.
sourceCoverageNotes: Second-mate module grouping, not syllabus: the learner-facing label is exactly 'Course Review', the closing group of this course on Foundation day F28 'Collections review and check'.

Course Review activity 1 is the existing review topic collections-streams/lambdas-and-streams/collections-and-streams-review ('Review: collections and streams'). It keeps its canonical id, source path, URL, content and count in its catalog module and is regrouped into Course Review by taxonomy placement only; it is not duplicated here.

Course Review activity 2 is this module's topic collections-and-streams-review-scenarios ('Review scenarios: collections and streams'): a new review asset that shares F28 row 0 'Collections and streams review' with activity 1. It is not one of the 243 canonical topics. It retrieves and applies taught material in new cross-topic scenarios and adds one small API detail, which it teaches itself before use: the three-argument Collectors.groupingBy whose middle argument is a map factory, usually written as a constructor reference.

Course Review closes with the course-level graded final MCQ collections-streams/assessments/collections-streams-final-mcq. Its value-free coverage map is authoring/evidence/collections-streams/course-final-mcq-coverage.md; graded questions, options, keys and scoring are never committed.
timed-coding-screen-patterns is a review topic that practises interview-screen patterns taught earlier; it stays in lambdas-and-streams, ordered before Course Review, and is not regrouped.
